Navigation text should be skipped by the scanner even though it contains ordinary English words.

Auto-T Manual Smoke Fixture

This local page is used to verify visible translation, page translation, restore behavior, short button labels, and dynamic content scanning.

Build Overview

This guide explains how Auto-T should scan normal article text, preserve the original content, and place the translated result close to the source paragraph.

The scanner should keep inline text together even when a sentence contains a bold phrase, an emphasized phrase, and a local anchor link.

  • Visible translation should prioritize the text currently near the viewport.
  • Page translation should collect more content without including navigation or code blocks.
  • Restore should remove every Auto-T translation node and return the page to its original layout.

Code And Skip Rules

The text around this code block should be translated, but source code should remain untouched because code snippets are usually not useful translation targets. 

const shouldNotTranslate = true;
function keepCodeReadable() {
  return "Auto-T should skip this block";
}
Scroll down after translating the first section to test visible scanning in a later viewport.

Dynamic Content Zone

Enable Auto visible on scroll in the popup, then click the buttons at the top of the page. Newly inserted sections should become translation candidates without pressing Retry.

Footer text should be ignored by scanner rules and should not consume translation quota.
